_comment: Absolute budgets of ARCHITECTURE-MAC section 12.3.2. Edited only in P1 and P2, with the reviewer's sign-off. scripts/perf-sample.sh and scripts/perf-check.sh read this file.
_energyNote: energyImpact is top's POWER column. It tracks CPU% closely (it is not Activity Monitor's energy model, and no root-free source of that exists), so a breach only warns. The battery-menu check by hand in P1 and P2 is the real energy gate. IDLEW (idleWakeupsPerSec) counts only interrupt/idle wakeups that top attributes to the process and undercounts timers coalesced by the kernel; treat it as a lower bound.
_notMeasuredUntil: A budgeted metric that is missing from a result FAILS scripts/perf-check.sh, unless it is listed here as '<scenario>.<metric>': '<first milestone that measures it>' and the milestone being checked is earlier. Edited only in P1 and P2.
_soakNote: P1: soak-5 footprintGrowthMB is the low of the last whole-cycle window minus the low of the whole-cycle window that starts at minute 10 (each window 1.1 x cycleSeconds + one minute, scripts/perf-summary.py), not 'last minute minus minute 10': the 5-minute navigation cycle builds and releases the 2,000-row ConfigMaps store, a 15-20 MB sawtooth, and the old definition passed or failed by the phase at the two ends (M1b: +19 MB and -9 MB for one build). footprintSlopeMBPerHour (least squares from minute 10) is informational: 18 MB/h is the same 15 MB spread over the 50 measured minutes.
_launchNote: P1: coldLaunchP90Sec is open to the first on-screen window (which may be the Starting view); firstContentP90Sec is open to the first content (the workspace or the welcome screen: the FirstContent signpost and the Darwin notification that scripts/perf-launch.swift waits for). Both are p90 by nearest rank.
